review.readiness_note: Sign off for the captured 390px resting state. The capture shows the thread and its controls intact; message delivery, keyboard behavior and navigation execution are not verifiable from pixels.

Production carries over the mineral and white surfaces, strong heading treatment, restrained borders, supporting text contrast and cobalt selection language. The participant and Story request context precede a readable chronology and incoming message. The long request title truncates within its header allocation without colliding with adjacent controls. The composer and all five navigation destinations remain unobstructed, and the targeted Business-current correction is visible. There is no money or inspectable source in this thread that warrants importing the Lab’s financial hierarchy or offset media joint. No release-blocking visual drift is evident.
review.verdict: Frame Shift was faithfully transferred to this Messages thread, with the Business-current fix visible and no functional loss apparent in the capture.
